text_annotations.text: 1  /  SOCKETED XIAO - USB FACES TOP EDGE

J1/J2 are physical female sockets. Pin 1 is nearest USB.
J2 pins are numbered top-to-bottom, not module DIP order.
15.24 mm row spacing; 2.54 mm pitch. No carrier 5V connection.

R1: remove to isolate / measure display supply.
Hold RESET low and CS high before SPI starts.
GPIO19=SCK, GPIO18=MOSI; start at 1 MHz.
Power off Wi-Fi before refresh.

Boost controlled by UC8179 through GDR / RESE.
Q1: 1=gate, 2=source, 3=drain. D1-D3: 1=cathode.
Kelvin pickup on RESE; short SW loop; 50V bias MLCCs.
Reference: Good Display GDEY075T7 rev1.0 p40.

Pin 4 is NC. Pin 5 VSHR is NOT pin 21 PREVGH.
Pin 18 VDD_INTERNAL receives only C6, never external 3V3.
TSCL / TSDA / VPP unused per reference. BS1=GND.
Check flex orientation before inserting the panel.

All rail capacitors non-polar MLCC. Bias-dependent capacitance must be checked against the exact panel lot.
No high-voltage rail is an external supply input. Fit panel and module only after inspection / resistance checks.

Four M2.5 non-plated holes. USB supply 5V / >=1A.
SMT top side only; sockets hand-soldered after reflow.
